name: Sennhütte
kurzbeschreibung:
**Alpine Hut in St. Anton am Arlberg**

Discover the cozy charm of a traditional **Sennhütte** nestled in the heart of the **Arlberg** region. Just a short drive from **St. Anton am Arlberg**, these rustic mountain huts offer an authentic taste of Tyrolean hospitality.

Savor freshly prepared dishes like hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, creamy **Käsekrainer**, and aromatic **Gröstl**, all made with local ingredients. Enjoy the breathtaking views of snow-capped peaks while relaxing by the crackling fireplace.

Whether you're seeking a peaceful retreat or an unforgettable culinary experience, a visit to a **Sennhütte** is a must for every traveler exploring **Tirol**.
